description: Update an existing Incident State in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_incident_state afterwards to see the updated record.

color.description: Color of this resource in Hex (#32a852 for example).

description.description: Friendly description that will help you remember.
description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Incident State to update. Required. Use list_incident_states to find IDs.

isAcknowledgedState.description: Is it the acknowledged state of the incident?

isCreatedState.description: Is it the created state of the incident?

isResolvedState.description: Is it the resolved state of the incident?

name.description: Any friendly name of this object.

order.description: Where this state sits in the project's list of incident states: 1 is the top. Incidents only ever move down the list, and an incident in a state at or below the acknowledged (or resolved) state counts as acknowledged (or resolved), so the created, acknowledged and resolved states have to stay in that order. A new state without a number goes just above the resolved state. Setting a number moves the state to that place, and the ones in between shift by one. In the dashboard, drag the rows to reorder them.
